Based on the provided documents, Valtteri Bottas won one Grand Prix for Mercedes: the 2021 Turkish Grand Prix (Document 2), where he started from pole and finished first. The other documents show him finishing 2nd at the 2020 Tuscan Grand Prix, 3rd at the 2020 70th Anniversary Grand Prix, 6th at the 2021 United States Grand Prix, and 9th at the 2022 Monaco Grand Prix (the last one for Alfa Romeo). The documents cover only a small selection of races, so this count may not be complete for 2000–2025.

ANSWER: 1
